climate.basis: A coastal ridge (crest y145-153 near z3500-3900) stands 13-20 blocks above the interior, and the northern range reaches y167 north of it. A wind from the west-northwest drops its moisture on both and leaves the interior plateau in their lee.
climate.snowline: y165 in the Northern Range; snow to sea level on the Northern Isles; snow on the Glacier Valley floor and walls as a deliberate glacial exception; no snowline on the Ember Highlands, which are warm and leeward.

regions.character: A snow-capped massif on the windward north-west, summits clipped flat at the height ceiling, falling through snowy spruce to a windswept northern foreshore.

boundary_basis.detail: Smoothed y128 contour. The B4 foothill peaks (y178-182) join the main massif at y128 and separate at y132.
The A1 summit is bounded by its own y110 contour. Its neck stays below y90, so it never joins by contour; its surrounding shore (0.28 km2) is included to keep the region contiguous.
The y120-128 band between the range and the plateau goes to whichever high core is nearer, which removes a thin halo the plateau contour would otherwise wrap around the range.
North-shore land pinned between the range and the sea, where the strip is at most 560 blocks wide, is range foreshore. It ends where the gap opens into the Downs.

bands.rule: below y128, including the north foreshore

distinctness.ground: Snow and grey stone above y148; spruce litter and podzol below.
distinctness.vegetation: None above the treeline; dense windswept spruce below.
distinctness.sightlines: Dominates every northern view; long views from any height.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: White summits or the snowline are in view from anywhere inside, and the ground is never level for long.

notes: The north foreshore is a compromise: only 9% of it lies within 16 blocks of mountain ground. It drains north and is cut off from the Windward Coast by the A1 massif, so it has no better contiguous home.
Gives 0.013 km2 at the glacier head to the Glacier Valley.
Underground: deep_dark in its cave systems (see underground_biomes).

regions.character: A rain-soaked old-growth coast on the west, dark canopy running down to a rocky shore under the full weight of the prevailing wind.

boundary_basis.detail: Land draining to the western sea, by priority-flood. Its inland edge is the drainage divide with the plateau and the rift.
Where a coastal ridge exists (crest y145-153 near z3500-3900, 13-20 blocks above the interior) the divide follows it.

bands.rule: the flattest dark-forest ground (slope < 2 degrees) at y 96-112, the sheltered hollows

distinctness.ground: Moss, podzol and coarse dirt; stony shore at the sea.
distinctness.vegetation: Closed dark-oak and old spruce canopy, the densest on the mainland.
distinctness.sightlines: Short inland; open only at the shore.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: A dark, closed canopy with the sea glimpsed through the trees.

notes: pale_garden is not a vanilla 1.21.1 biome. It is loaded by VanillaBackport, already world-critical; painting it binds the save to that mod. One spawn entry references it and no species depends on it alone.

regions.character: A dry, flat tableland in the rain shadow of the coastal ridge and the range: sun-bleached grass, scattered acacia and a sandy desert heart.

boundary_basis.detail: Smoothed y120 contour around the D2 tableland (interior y127-143).
Sheltered to the west by the coastal ridge where present and to the north by the range, from a WNW wind.

distinctness.ground: Yellow-brown grass and coarse dirt; sand at the core.
distinctness.sightlines: Very long over a flat horizon.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: The flattest ground on the map and the only dry yellow grassland in the mainland interior.

notes: Flattest region: 72.1% of its land is under 5 degrees.
Largest site: 114 blocks square at (1224, 4170), y133-137.
savanna is new here and carries the optional #cobblemon:is_shrubland overlay.

regions.character: A high, open upland between the range's foot, the rift's north rim and the glacier valley: wind-cut grass and stone, old pines toward the mountains, and the rift opening at its southern edge.

boundary_basis.detail: Its north-east edge is the Glacier Valley: the trough's rim level along the measured axis.
Its southern edge is the rift's rim.
Its north-west edge is the Northern Range's smoothed y128 contour.
Split from the Eastern Downs, which the Glacier Valley now cuts in three. This is the piece west of the valley and north of the rift.

bands.rule: everything else: open wind-cut upland on the rift's north rim

distinctness.ground: Short grass broken by stone and gravel; scree at the rift rim.
distinctness.vegetation: Almost treeless hills; tall old pines above y132 toward the range.
distinctness.sightlines: Down into the rift from its rim; the range and the glacier valley behind.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Bare, wind-cut hills with either the rift or the range's old pines in view.

notes: Hub tier follows its sites: 106 blocks square at (3149, 2768) y122-126 and 100 at (3401, 2951), both formerly counted for the Eastern Downs.
71% of its land is under 5 degrees; median y121; median 1,888 blocks from the sea.

regions.character: A branching tear through the centre of the island, walls falling 50-65 blocks to a floor that is never seen: fog, portal light and sound rising from below. Players descend into it.

boundary_basis.detail: The enclosed rift water plus land within 240 blocks of it whose slope is at least 9 degrees or whose height is at most y100. The measured rim sits near y99 and the walls average 21 degrees within 64 blocks of the water.

wanted: ambient particles: nether portal, reverse portal, soul fire flame

distinctness.ground: Stone and gravel walls; no visible floor.
distinctness.water: None. The floor lies below sea level and must never hold water.
distinctness.sightlines: Across to the far rim; nothing below the fog.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Fog and portal particles rising out of a trench in the ground.

notes: Not water and not dry land. The floor (y44-62) stays below sea level, must not be filled with water, and must not render as a visible surface: void, barrier, or a light-emitting layer below reach, decided later.

Biome and spawn table deferred. A custom datapack biome is required: heavy fog, custom sky and fog colour, ambient particles (nether portal, reverse portal, soul fire flame), an ambient sound loop, light from below. No ocean or vanilla default biome is assigned.
data/landmarks.json marks it water: never; landforms.py and cell_stats.py count its floor as void, not inland water.
Victory Road / League suitability is assessed in docs/world-building/REGIONS.md, not decided.
The previous plan called this the Sunken Rift and gave it river, windswept_gravelly_hills and mangrove_swamp. Those biomes now live in the Glacier Valley and the Strand Flats.

regions.character: A glacier tongue filling a long trough from the range's south-east flank to a meltwater lake held behind a gravel moraine, drained east to the sea by a single river.

boundary_basis.detail: Inside the annotated glacier outline, ground no higher than the lower rim of its nearest cross-section station (smoothed over three stations) minus 2 blocks, kept as the component on the trough axis.
The enclosed meltwater lake (0.22 km2 below sea level, floor y44.5).
Ground within 90 blocks of the planned moraine crest and within 72 blocks of the planned meltwater river channel, from data/landmarks.json.

bands.rule: everything else: the lower walls around the lake
the valley floor within 90 blocks of the trough axis, from the head to d3100 (the glacier tongue)
the meltwater lake and the planned meltwater river channel (within 24 blocks of it)
the planned terminal moraine (within 90 blocks of its crest)

distinctness.ground: Ice and packed snow on the valley floor; gravel on the moraine; snow under spruce on the walls.
distinctness.vegetation: Snowy spruce on the upper walls, taiga around the lake, none on the ice.
distinctness.water: The meltwater lake and the river leaving it.
distinctness.sightlines: Along the valley axis, once carved; today the saddle at d1800 blocks the view.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: A white, flat-floored valley between dark spruce walls.

notes: Status partial: the trough exists but is under-carved (median wall 5.5 degrees, median depth 19.6 blocks, a 4-block saddle at d1792). A WorldPainter hand-carve is specified in docs/world-building/GLACIER_CARVE.md and data/landmarks.json.
Snow below the treeline is deliberate here and is the one exception to 'snow above y165': a glacier and cold-air drainage from the range.

The flat ground that earned Stillwater Basin hub tier in the previous pass lies inside this valley: 139 blocks square at (5646, 3302) y75-78, and 104, 103, 103 and 100. The carve as specified narrows the floor; the largest flat square on the carved floor is 124 blocks.
The moraine and the river are planned features and exist only as a spec.

regions.character: Sheltered rolling ground between the rift's south-east arm, the glacier's lake and the Ember Highlands, reaching the east coast: cherry groves over a swampy low end.

boundary_basis.detail: What remains of the D6 lake's drainage basin once the Glacier Valley is taken out.
Its northern edge is the Glacier Valley.
Takes the east-coast land south of the valley mouth that the valley cut off from the Eastern Downs; bounded by the valley, the rift's south-east arm, the Ember Highlands contour and the sea.

bands.rule: y <= 84: the low ground against the rift's south-east arm

distinctness.ground: Grass; mud and clay at the lake.
distinctness.vegetation: Pink cherry canopy over an open understorey.
distinctness.water: Swampy low ground against the rift; the sea on the east coast strip.
distinctness.sightlines: Inward to the lake, bounded by the basin rim.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Pink canopy. Unmistakable from any distance.

notes: Kept as its own region and hub, as directed. The measurement behind the directive has changed: the enclosed lake it was named for is the glacier's meltwater lake, and all of its previous hub sites lie inside the glacier trough. Name kept pending your call.

Hub tier is still supported by flat ground: 104 blocks square at (6805, 4407) y107-109 on the east coast, inherited from the Eastern Downs. Its best site in the old basin area is 96 blocks at (6205, 4791), below the 99-block bar used for tiers.
The east-coast strip south of the valley mouth is narrow, about 250 blocks, where it runs beside the Ember Highlands.

regions.character: Open rolling grassland on the north and east coasts beyond the glacier valley, rising to high meadow in the north, broken by birch copses.

boundary_basis.detail: Land draining to the north and east seas.
Its south-west edge is the Glacier Valley, which splits it from the Rim Uplands and Stillwater Basin.
Its north-west edge is where the range foreshore ends.

distinctness.ground: Short green grass and dirt paths.
distinctness.vegetation: Open grassland with scattered birch copses; flowering meadow on the northern rise.
distinctness.water: Small streams toward the east coast.
distinctness.sightlines: Long and rolling; the snow range on the north-western skyline.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Open green country with pale birch stands and the snow range on the skyline.

notes: Reduced from 8.61 to 3.58 km2: the Glacier Valley took 1.56 km2 and cut the rest in three.

Hub tier kept: its largest site is 107 blocks square at (6446, 3527) y92-94, beside the glacier valley mouth, then 99 at (6209, 2738). Its C4 sites went to the Rim Uplands and its E7 site to Stillwater Basin.

regions.character: A scorched volcanic tableland near y150 crowned by four clipped cones: red badlands below, wooded mesa tops, broken ash-coloured ground on the flanks.

boundary_basis.detail: Smoothed y135 contour connected to the four cones, taking in the y150 F5 tableland they stand on.

bands.rule: everything else: the broken tableland and cone flanks

distinctness.ground: Red and orange terracotta and coarse dirt; basalt and ash from the kit palette.
distinctness.vegetation: None on the tableland; sparse dry savanna below y142.
distinctness.sightlines: Long; the cones are landmarks from the Vale and across the rift.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Red eroded ground and flat-topped cones.

notes: No snowline: the cone tops are stony peaks, not snow, because the region is warm and in the lee.
#cobblemon:is_volcanic and #cobblemon:is_thermal have no loaded member biome; both require the eroded_badlands tag overlay.
badlands and wooded_badlands are new here, so all three badlands variants are covered.
Underground: sulfur_caves (VanillaBackport) under the cones is optional.

regions.character: Deep mixed forest on the rift's south shore, opening into flowered glades on its flatter ground.

boundary_basis.detail: Land draining to the south sea plus the rift's south shore, less the Strand Flats.

distinctness.ground: Grass and forest floor; flowers in the glades.
distinctness.vegetation: Closed oak and birch canopy with flower glades.
distinctness.water: The rift shore to the north.
distinctness.sightlines: Short in forest; long across glades and the lake.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Closed but bright forest broken by flower meadows, lighter than the Windward Coast.

notes: Tiered route, not hub: 60% of its land is under 5 degrees but only in small patches. Its largest flat square is 96 blocks.

#cobblemon:is_lush has one loaded member, lush_caves, planned underground here. The flower_forest overlay from the previous plan stays as a fallback until an export proves the underground biome works, because every fossil species depends on is_lush.
old_growth_birch_forest is new here.

regions.character: The lowest ground on the mainland's south coast: a sandy strand backed by sunflower flats. Designated as the map's flat coastal lowland.

boundary_basis.detail: South-sea watershed, y100 or lower, within 700 blocks of the sea. The mask is eroded by 64 blocks to remove the thin beach ribbon along the rest of the coast, then regrown by the same distance.

bands.rule: y <= 82 behind the beach (the lowest ground; needs the flattening pass)

distinctness.vegetation: Sunflowers and low grass; no trees.
distinctness.water: Open sea along the whole southern edge.
distinctness.sightlines: Open to the sea and the Southern Isles.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Sand, sunflowers and open sea, with nothing overhead.

notes: Status partial: designated the flat coastal lowland, but only 37.8% of its land is under 5 degrees. It needs a terrain flattening pass.
mangrove_swamp moved here from the rift. It needs low, wet, near-sea-level ground, which the flattening pass has to create.

regions.character: Three cold, low islands off the north coast, snow-covered to their shores.

boundary_basis.detail: Three separate islands (A6, A8, B7). Contiguity is impossible by definition.

bands.rule: flat interior (slope < 4 degrees, >= 160 blocks from the sea)

distinctness.sightlines: Open across cold sea to the range.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: The only snow at sea level.

notes: ice_spikes is new here. In the pack scope it is the only biome that reaches Kyurem.

regions.character: A long, ridged island off the east coast under dense jungle, with bamboo along its crest.

boundary_basis.detail: A single island, G8.

distinctness.ground: Jungle floor and podzol; sand at the shore.
distinctness.vegetation: Very dense jungle; bamboo above y125.
distinctness.sightlines: Short under the canopy; open from the crest.

notes: Underground: lush_caves.

regions.character: Warm, open islands off the south and west coasts under sparse jungle, with one mushroom islet in the west.

boundary_basis.detail: Three separate islands (H2, H6, F1). Contiguity is impossible by definition.

distinctness.ground: Sand and grass; mycelium on the F1 islet.
distinctness.signature_at_128_blocks: Open sunlit islands; the mycelium islet is unmistakable.

notes: The F1 mushroom islet is a deliberate anomaly: mushroom_fields is the only vanilla source of is_island.
